title: hemigraphis rupestris
intro: Hemigraphis rupestris, commonly known as the "Rock Garden Ivy" or "Thai Signal Plant", is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and boosting the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin care. Bioactive constituents present in Hemigraphis rupestris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
